description: Five captured queries (84 visible rendered headers) surfaced late-November arrests/raids, constitutional-reform reporting and a 27 November statement by exiled Nicaraguans, but no public gathering inside Nicaragua with an actual occurrence, simultaneous threshold and own-state demand. Search results also include 2018-cycle history and a December-published Amnesty report. No event absence is inferred.
